meta.name: reanimate
meta.description: Clone a section, widget, page or animation from any reference (a live website URL, a screen recording, an mp4/mov/webm, a gif, a Lottie file, a prototype export) frame by frame into the user's own codebase, then record the clone and verify it against the reference frame by frame, iterating until timing, easing, sequence and layout match. Use whenever the user wants to clone, copy, replicate, recreate, reverse-engineer, port or "steal" a hero, section, widget, marquee, carousel, hover effect, page transition, loader, scroll animation or interaction from a site or video, says "make it look/feel/move like this", "same animation as", "match this exactly", or hands over a gif/video and asks to build it, including when they also want to add their own content, colours or extra features on top, or only want part of the reference (one section, one widget, a few seconds). Covers canvas, WebGL, WebGPU and three.js / 3D scenes (shaders, particles, globes, glTF models) as well as CSS and JS motion. Pixel-level matching of
